title: Playboy September 1987 Women of 007 Maryam d'Abo Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, September 1987 - The Women of 007, celebrating three decades of James Bond in Playboy. Original $3.50 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Centerfold: Gwendolyn Hajek.

Cover features: The Women of 007; Plus 007's dangerous new sensation, Maryam d'Abo; Spy Wars: Has the K.G.B. Cracked the CIA?; Who Are the N.F.L.'s Best? Pro Football Preview; The 1987 Scandal Test.

Back cover: Marlboro cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
